about: Session X Part 2: findings of scripts/check-secrets.mjs that are known test values in another lane and handed off for a fix (docs/handoff/X_CLOUD_TO_LOCAL.md). Each entry names one file, one check and the sha256 of the exact matched text, so it hides that one value only; a new value in the same file is still a finding. An entry whose value is gone prints a warning and never fails CI: remove it in the next change (whichever lane merges second). Never add a real credential here.

entries.reason: A fictional key in ZIGi's memory refusal test (X-LOCAL lane); the runtime-built replacement is in docs/handoff/X_CLOUD_TO_LOCAL.md.
